name: empty_list_opens_tab
spec_quote: If there is no tab, it opens one with `PUT <cdp>/json/new?about:blank` and returns `True`.

name: single_page_no_op
spec_quote: If at least one tab exists, `ensure_tab` changes nothing: it makes no other request and returns `False`.

name: multiple_pages_no_op
spec_quote: If at least one tab exists, `ensure_tab` changes nothing: it makes no other request and returns `False`.

name: page_and_service_worker_no_op
spec_quote: A target counts as a tab only when its `type` is `page`.

name: only_service_worker_opens
spec_quote: A list whose only targets are not `page` also means no tab.

name: only_background_page_opens
spec_quote: Service workers, background pages, extensions and other types do not count.

name: only_iframe_opens
spec_quote: A target counts as a tab only when its `type` is `page`.

name: only_extension_opens
spec_quote: Service workers, background pages, extensions and other types do not count.

name: only_other_type_opens
spec_quote: A target counts as a tab only when its `type` is `page`.

name: trailing_slash_empty_list_opens
spec_quote: The trailing slash of `cdp` is ignored (`http://127.0.0.1:9222/` and `http://127.0.0.1:9222` give the same URLs).

name: trailing_slash_page_exists_no_op
spec_quote: The trailing slash of `cdp` is ignored (`http://127.0.0.1:9222/` and `http://127.0.0.1:9222` give the same URLs).

name: trailing_slash_only_nonpage_opens
spec_quote: The trailing slash of `cdp` is ignored (`http://127.0.0.1:9222/` and `http://127.0.0.1:9222` give the same URLs).

name: listing_unreachable_returns_false
spec_quote: If Chrome is not reachable (the listing raises `OSError`), `ensure_tab` does not raise and does not try to open a tab; it returns `False` — the later `connect_over_cdp` reports the real error.

name: listing_unreachable_trailing_slash_returns_false
spec_quote: If Chrome is not reachable (the listing raises `OSError`), `ensure_tab` does not raise and does not try to open a tab; it returns `False` — the later `connect_over_cdp` reports the real error.

name: listing_object_returns_false
spec_quote: If the listing is not a list (unexpected answer), it is treated like an unreachable Chrome: no request, returns `False`.

name: listing_object_with_page_type_returns_false
spec_quote: If the listing is not a list (unexpected answer), it is treated like an unreachable Chrome: no request, returns `False`.

name: empty_list_new_tab_unreachable
spec_quote: If opening the tab raises `OSError`, `ensure_tab` does not raise and returns `False`.

name: only_nonpage_new_tab_unreachable
spec_quote: If opening the tab raises `OSError`, `ensure_tab` does not raise and returns `False`.

name: trailing_slash_new_tab_unreachable
spec_quote: The trailing slash of `cdp` is ignored (`http://127.0.0.1:9222/` and `http://127.0.0.1:9222` give the same URLs).

name: several_nonpage_targets_open_once
spec_quote: `ensure_tab` never closes, navigates or changes an existing tab, and never opens more than one tab per call.

name: page_among_nonpage_targets_no_op
spec_quote: If at least one tab exists, `ensure_tab` changes nothing: it makes no other request and returns `False`.

name: page_with_extra_fields_no_op
spec_quote: If at least one tab exists, `ensure_tab` changes nothing: it makes no other request and returns `False`.

name: target_without_type_opens
spec_quote: A target counts as a tab only when its `type` is `page`.

name: duplicate_page_ids_no_op
